purpose: Prove a bounded APNG sidecar decoder for two full-canvas 8-bit RGBA source frames without claiming full APNG or PNG conformance.

external_sources.name: W3C Portable Network Graphics (PNG) Specification, Third Edition
external_sources.used_for: APNG acTL, fcTL, fdAT chunk structure, sequence numbers, dispose, and blend semantics.

limitations: Stage 0 APNG decoder supports two full-canvas 8-bit RGBA source frames only.
Frame semantics remain sidecar-bound; APNG pixels do not encode Mechagotchi organs.
Blend-over, partial-frame offsets, disposal variants, APNG text/private metadata, and full APNG/PNG conformance are not claimed.
Live external editor open-save preservation is not verified by this lab.
